response.content: {"findings":[{"location":"Poem, stanza 1","severity":"minor","source_quote":"To carry, to store, or for a drink?","suggested_fix":"Change to “Att bära, förvara eller dricka ur?” so the lines describe what the vessel is for, rather than imply that someone carries or stores something inside it.","translation_quote":"Ett att bära i, förvara i eller dricka ur?"},{"location":"Poem, stanza 3","severity":"minor","source_quote":"About my life / are many others,","suggested_fix":"Use a natural Swedish equivalent such as “I mitt liv / finns många andra,”.","translation_quote":"Runt mitt liv / finns många andra,"},{"location":"Poem, stanza 4","severity":"minor","source_quote":"Making each of us, something new.","suggested_fix":"Change to “och gör var och en av oss till något nytt.” The translation adds “igen” (again), which is not in the source.","translation_quote":"gör var och en av oss till något nytt igen."},{"location":"Poem, stanza 5","severity":"minor","source_quote":"Until His likeness, again does show.","suggested_fix":"Change “framträder där” to “åter framträder” to preserve the sense that the Potter’s likeness appears again, without adding a location.","translation_quote":"tills hans likhet åter framträder där."},{"location":"Poem, stanza 6","severity":"minor","source_quote":"Lest other’s pots become concave.","suggested_fix":"Use a direct Swedish equivalent of “concave,” such as “så att andras krukor inte blir konkava.” “Intryckta” suggests dented or pressed in, rather than concave.","translation_quote":"så att andras krukor inte blir intryckta."}],"passed":true,"score":95}
